newsitem.title: USA: Applied Materials to invest $430 million in facilities.
newsitem.headline: Applied Materials to invest $430 million in facilities.

text.p: Applied Materials Inc. said Monday it will invest more than $430 million over the next two years to expand its product development and demonstration laboratories in Santa Clara, Calif.

The world's largest supplier of semiconductor wafer fabrication equipment said the investment will support a revenue level of at least $10 billion. It said the expansion plans were targeted toward meeting increasing demand for equipment to make the latest generation of semiconductors.

To provide immediate technical capability, the company said a building in Santa Clara will be converted into a development and applications centre exclusively for 300 mm semiconductors at a cost of about $121 million.

To provide additional future capabilities, about $309 million will be used to construct and equip a new applications laboratory facility at its Arques Campus, the company said. The expected project completion date is February 1999.
Applied Materials' stock rose 62.5 cents to $79.875 on Nasdaq in late morning trading.
